name: Juggernaut XL
description: Juggernaut XL v9 — a photorealistic SDXL model. Create an image from text, restyle a whole image, or inpaint a masked area. All three nodes share one set of weights.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Describe the image to create.

params_schema.label: Negative Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Things to avoid. Juggernaut XL works best with none — add specifics only as needed.

params_schema.label: Quality Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Juggernaut XL v9 recommends 30-40 steps.

params_schema.label: Prompt Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Model card recommends 3-7; lower is more realistic.

params_schema.label: Aspect Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: SDXL native resolutions. The model card recommends 832x1216 / 1216x832.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Random seed (-1 for random). Set a value for repeatable results.

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Describe the whole picture you want back. This node redraws the entire image, so it cannot keep parts unchanged. To change just one area, use the Inpaint node.

params_schema.label: Negative Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Things to avoid.

params_schema.label: Restyle Strength
params_schema.tooltip: How much of the original is kept while redrawing. Low (0.3-0.5) stays closer, high (0.6-0.8) changes more. Note: the whole image is redrawn either way.

params_schema.label: Prompt Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Model card recommends 3-7; lower is more realistic.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Random seed (-1 for random).

params_schema.label: What to select
params_schema.tooltip: Type the part of the image to select, for example 'sky' or 'the bicycle'. The node outputs a white-on-black mask image.

params_schema.label: Threshold
params_schema.tooltip: Higher = smaller, stricter selection. Lower = larger, looser selection.

params_schema.label: Invert
params_schema.tooltip: Invert the mask. Useful to keep the subject and replace the background.

params_schema.label: Expand (px)
params_schema.tooltip: Grow the mask a little so edges don't leave seams.

params_schema.label: Feather (px)
params_schema.tooltip: Soften the mask edge.

params_schema.label: Mask Source
params_schema.tooltip: Where the mask comes from. 'Connected mask' uses the second image input. The transparency options use an image with a see-through area (for example the output of Remove Background).

params_schema.label: Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Describe what should appear inside the masked area.

params_schema.label: Negative Prompt
params_schema.tooltip: Things to avoid.

params_schema.label: Inpaint Strength
params_schema.tooltip: How strongly the masked area is regenerated. 0.8-1.0 is typical.

params_schema.label: Prompt Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Model card recommends 3-7; lower is more realistic.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Random seed (-1 for random).
